query: the skill I wrote yesterday isn't triggering. I ask for exactly the thing it covers and the agent just does it the long way without ever opening it. what's wrong with it
pass_if: writing-skills (or skill-creator, which owns description-triggering work) loads, OR maintaining-skills loads first and its triage hands off to writing-skills within one step
why_this_points_there: A skill that is one day old cannot have decayed. The defect is in its description, a creation-side problem. Surface features (an existing skill misbehaving, 'what's wrong with it') pull toward maintaining-skills. skill-creator is an acceptable terminal because it owns description optimisation; maintaining-skills' triage only names writing-skills, which is fine.
